# TiRex (xLSTM, 35M).  Plain `tirex-ts` is enough: without the `xlstm` package it uses its pure-PyTorch backend
# (load_model backend="torch"), so NO nvcc / CUDA compiler is needed (the GPU machine has none).
# The optional `tirex-ts[cuda]` extra compiles custom sLSTM kernels (needs nvcc, compute capability >= 8.0).  NXAI community licence.
